user.title: TuxWall Gateway
user.description: Connect to your TuxWall router's dashboard API.

data.totp_code: TOTP code (only if 2FA is enabled on the account)
data.ca_cert: Router CA certificate file (e.g. /config/tuxwall-ca.crt; empty = system trust store)

error.cannot_connect: Cannot reach the TuxWall dashboard at that host.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid credentials (or wrong TOTP code / locked out).
error.ssl_error: The router's certificate is not trusted: give its CA file (dashboard Settings → Security → HTTPS → Download CA certificate, copied into the Home Assistant config folder).
error.use_https: TuxWall redirects http to https: enter the host as https://… and give the router's CA file.

abort.already_configured: This TuxWall host is already configured.

ban_device.name: Ban device
ban_device.description: Cuts a client's internet access (UFW deny + Unbound DNS block). Requires an admin tuxwall user.

unban_device.name: Unban device
unban_device.description: Restores internet access for a banned client.
